blocks.text: Match preview: Otago face Canterbury in 9th Match (ODI) on Wed, 4 Nov, 2026, 3:00 am at University Oval Dunedin. Full pitch report, weather forecast, and squad details below.
Standard ODI surface expected. Conditions will be clearer at the toss — monitor team selection and dew factor for night games.
Expected par score: 250–290 runs par score.
Drizzle · High 16°C / Low 9°C · Rain: 3 mm · Wind: up to 24 km/h. Light rain possible — overcast conditions could assist swing bowling early.
International playing XI is announced at the toss. Check back on match day for confirmed line-ups.
